title: Credential Handling
description: Handle user credentials and API keys safely at runtime.

data.text:
**Credential Handling**

Credentials include passwords, API keys, tokens, and certificates. Mishandling them is the fastest way to compromise an application.

items: Hash with bcrypt, Argon2, or PBKDF2
Never store or log plaintext passwords
Store in secure, HTTP-only cookies or memory

data.title: ASP.NET Core Password Hashing
Logging Credentials
data.text: Never log passwords, tokens, or full request bodies with credentials. Use scrubbing middleware.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Use HTTPS for all credential transport
data.takeaway: Credentials are the crown jewels - protect them at every layer.
